scope: Resumable fixed-history continuation feasibility screen; no learned model and no claim of unexpected online information
checkpoint_phase: after completions, before new starts at the selected completion timestamp
proposal_order: diagonal round-robin over resource-feasible actions and four continuation rules; fixed before qualification
beam_deduplication: unique realized assignment/start/end schedules, with stage evaluation counts retained
aggregation: Both bars use median paired percentage reduction relative to the matched hand continuation, across physical workflows; incumbent gain is reported separately
primary: One checkpoint: branch on ready operation/eligible host or waiting for next event, evaluate whole remaining-workflow continuations using four predeclared rank rules
matched_hand: Same snapshot, information, 32-score/250-ms limits and exact evaluator; hand graph priority starts plus seeded suffix placement/priority annealing
retry: If either primary bar fails, retain top four first-decision continuations, branch again after their next completion; same served budget on disjoint cases, at most 256-score slow reference
reference: Feasible bounded larger search including incumbent and served arms; never a global optimum
live: Every qualification case replays incumbent, hand, candidate and bounded reference through actual HeROsim, even after offline failure; compare every start, completion, placement and setup event
audit: Every feasible evaluated continuation must preserve executed events and match full from-zero native materialized replay. Final arms also match independent SimPy. Preserve full candidate trace, inputs, source hashes and timings.
timing: Common snapshot/start charged separately and identically; full proposer construction and resume revalidation count against each decision budget. Stop conservatively before score overrun; timing violations invalidate performance claims.
limitations: Deterministic fully announced zero-I/O per-job DAGs; materialized live replay validates continuation execution, not a live online GNN callback. Python reference timing is not an optimized deployment result.
